# AEM Frozen Food (AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD.)
> Frozen food manufacturer and OEM contract manufacturer in Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia. No pork and no lard enter the plant. Chinese-style frozen products for B2B buyers, plus cold-chain wholesale across Peninsular Malaysia.

## What We Do
- **OEM / ODM contract manufacturing**: custom recipe development, private label packaging, standardised production for F&B brands and restaurant chains. Subject to a separate written agreement.
- **B2B wholesale supply**: bulk supply to restaurant chains, hawker stalls, supermarkets, hotels, caterers and distributors.
- **Cold-chain delivery**: temperature-controlled delivery across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor and Peninsular Malaysia.
- **Samples and quotations**: sample requests and bulk quotes via WhatsApp.

## Overview
- **Company**: AL-EKHLAS MANUFACTURING SDN. BHD. (Reg. No. 202401022253 / 1568102-T), brand AEM Frozen Food / 真心食品
- **Plant**: No 27, Jalan P4/5, Bandar Teknologi Kajang, 43500 Semenyih, Selangor, Malaysia
- **Catalogue**: 51 in-house SKUs across 10 categories
- **Service area**: Klang Valley (Kuala Lumpur & Selangor) and Peninsular Malaysia (Penang, Ipoh, Melaka, Johor, Kuantan)

## Product Catalogue (51 SKUs, 10 categories)

1. **Satay & Skewers 烧烤串** (6 SKUs, 400g packets and 20-packet cartons)
   - Sate Ayam 鸡肉串 · Sate Daging 牛肉串 · Sate Kambing 羊肉串
   - Sate Ayam Pedas Mala 麻辣鸡肉串 · Sate Daging Pedas Mala 麻辣牛肉串 · Sate Kambing Pedas Mala 麻辣羊肉串
2. **Frozen Dumplings 饺子系列** (4 SKUs, 2kg packs)
   - Chicken & Shiitake 鸡肉香菇饺子 · Chicken & Cabbage 鸡肉白菜饺子 · Beef & Leek 牛肉大葱饺子 · Mutton & White Radish 羊肉白萝卜饺子
3. **Ready-to-Eat Chinese Dishes 中式料理包** (8 SKUs, 200–350g pouches, 20-packet cartons)
   - 酸汤金汤肥牛 · 秘制红烧牛肉 · 滋补羊肉煲 · 香浓鸡肉煲 · 经典酸甜鸡块 · 鸡肉沫茄子 · 经典香菇焖鸡 · 秘制黄焖鸡
4. **Hotpot Soup Bases & Sauces 火锅底料 & 酱料** (7 SKUs, 500g–2kg packs)
   - 金汤花胶鸡汤底 · 正宗酸菜鱼汤底 · 鲜番茄火锅底料 · 泡椒酸辣鸡汤底 · 川味麻辣火锅底料 · 特级秘制红辣椒油 · 黄金蒜蓉蘸酱
5. **Herbal Soup Packs 养生汤包** (6 SKUs, 400g packets)
   - 椰子炖鸡汤底包 · 虎乳芝养肺鸡汤包 · 天麻安神补脑汤包 · 巴戟天强肾壮骨汤包 · 虫草花补肺滋肾汤包 · 枸杞菊花明目鸡汤包
6. **Chinese Dessert Soups 传统糖水** (5 SKUs, 300–500g packets)
   - 冰糖雪梨 (also in bucket format) · 海底椰龙眼糖水 · 菠萝龙眼糖水 · 传统花生糊
7. **Marinated Meat & Fish Slices 秘制腌制肉片** (3 SKUs, 250g–2kg packs)
   - 秘制腌制鱼片 · 秘制腌制牛肉片 · 秘制腌制羊肉片
8. **Fried Snacks 精致小吃** (5 SKUs)
   - 酥脆小酥肉 · 红糖糍粑 · 黄金南瓜饼 · 炸冰淇淋 (3 flavours) · 黄金炸鲜奶
9. **Flower Teas 花茶** (4 SKUs, 25g packs, 30-pack cartons)
   - 经典八宝茶 · 润燥美目茶 · 洛神花草茶 · 清火菊花茶
10. **Seasoning Powders 风味调味料** (3 SKUs, 500g packs)
    - 兰州牛肉面调料包 · 经典风味烧烤撒料包 · 秘制麻辣烧烤撒料包

## Ordering & Delivery
- **Klang Valley**: free cold-chain delivery on orders RM1,000 and above; RM40 flat fee below RM1,000.
- **Peninsular Malaysia outstation**: free cold-chain delivery on orders RM1,500 and above; RM40 flat fee below RM1,500.
- **Delivery time**: estimated 2–5 working days. All dates are estimates, not guarantees.
- **Storage**: all products are frozen. Keep at −18°C or below. Do not refreeze after thawing.
- **Orders**: WhatsApp +6014-941 3545. The website generates an enquiry message; it takes no payment and prices shown on it are reference only.

## Allergens
Products are made in a shared facility and may contain or come into contact with fish, crustaceans and shellfish, soy, peanut, tree nuts, sesame, gluten, egg and dairy. Buyers who resell, repack or serve the products are responsible for ingredient and allergen disclosure to end consumers.
